title: Equality of variance and total influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its variance equals its total influence if and only if every Fourier coefficient indexed by a subset of more than one coordinate is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
